items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the fine notice
items.quote: Einspruch gegen diesen Bußgeldbescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach seiner Zustellung einlegen.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) rather than sent by ordinary post; the delivery slip copied on page 2 states the actual service date as 22.09.2026 ('Zugestellt : 22.09.2026'). Because this is a formal Zustellung, the statutory deemed-delivery fiction for ordinary post does not apply — the stated service date is used directly as the start of the period. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service itself is not counted, so counting starts 23.09.2026. Two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB, § 43 StPO via § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) falls on Tuesday 06.10.2026, which is a normal business day in Thüringen, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed. The Einspruch must reach the Bußgeldstelle by this date (it is a receipt deadline, not a send-by date).

items.title: Pay the fine, fee and delivery costs once the decision is final
items.quote: Sobald der Bescheid rechtskräftig ist, haben Sie für die Zahlung des Gesamtbetrags zwei Wochen Zeit; geben Sie als Verwendungszweck bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: The Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period that ends 06.10.2026; finality is reached the following day, 07.10.2026. The letter then gives two weeks for payment from that point. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day finality occurs is not counted, so counting starts 08.10.2026; two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) falls on Wednesday 21.10.2026, a normal business day in Thüringen, so no shift applies. This date only holds if no Einspruch is filed by 06.10.2026 — an Einspruch would suspend the finality and thus this payment deadline.

warnings: The payment due date (21.10.2026) is only valid if no Einspruch is filed by 06.10.2026; filing an Einspruch suspends both the finality of the decision and the payment obligation until the outcome is decided.

The IBAN printed (DE85 8205 1000 0000 6551 00, Sparkasse Musterrode) is a structurally valid German IBAN, but as with any payment instruction it is worth confirming it matches earlier correspondence from this Bußgeldstelle before paying, since a valid IBAN format does not prove who owns the account.
